'''RegioExpress''', commonly abbreviated to '''RE''', is a [[Train categories in Europe|category]] of fast regional train service in [[Switzerland]], run by [[Swiss Federal Railways]] (SBB CFF FFS) or other railway companies (such as [[Treni Regionali Ticino Lombardia|TILO]], [[BLS AG|BLS]], [[transports publics Fribourgeois|tpf]], [[THURBO]] or [[Rhätische Bahn|RhB]], previously also by [[Transports publics Neuchâtelois|transN]]). A few lines also serve stations in Germany, France and Italy. Since 2023, all RE services are numbered for more clarity. Some of them are [[List of named passenger trains of Switzerland|named]].

It is comparable to the [[Regional-Express]] in [[Rail transport in Germany|Germany]], [[Rail transport in Austria|Austria]] and [[Rail transport in Luxembourg|Luxembourg]].<ref>{{cite web|title=RegioExpress Bern – Luzern|periodical=|publisher=MySwitzerland.com|url=https://www.myswitzerland.com/de-ch/regioexpress-bern-luzern.html|url-status=|format=|access-date=2018-11-12|archive-url=|archive-date=|last=|date=|year=|language=|pages=|quote=}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=BLS RegioExpress Lötschberger|periodical=|publisher=MySwitzerland.com|url=https://www.myswitzerland.com/de-ch/bls-regioexpress-loetschberger.html|url-status=|format=|access-date=2018-11-12|archive-url=|archive-date=|last=|date=|year=|language=|pages=|quote=}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Streckennetz: 384'000 Meter Schienen|periodical=|publisher=RhB|url=https://www.rhb.ch/de/service-souvenirs/streckennetz|url-status=|format=|access-date=2018-11-12|archive-url=|archive-date=|last=|date=|year=|language=|pages=|quote=}}</ref> Its speed is considerably faster than regional trains at the same level, as it does not stop at all stations served by the regional trains. Nonetheless, it is slightly slower than [[InterRegio]] trains. Swiss Federal Railways describes the trains as ones that serve "rapidly into the regions".

==History==
Until the 2003 timetable overhaul (December 2002 to December 2003), the RegioExpress was limited in circulation. One of the main lines which ran as a RegioExpress line (abbreviation: RX) was the ''Rheintal Express'', from [[St. Gallen]] through [[Sargans]] to [[Chur]] (the other was the ''CityVogel'' from [[Zürich]] to [[Konstanz]]). As of the 2004 timetable overhaul, the RegioExpress was introduced as faster [[Regio (Swiss railway train)|Regio]] (formerly regional) trains; the term was thrown into expanded usage. The abbreviation was changed to RE instead of the previous RX in the 2005 timetable. Recently, several companies have begun to number their RE lines, such as the TPF.
